title: Pithyx update source v1
description: `pithyx-source.json` (D339): an update source a box can switch to in its recovery menu, for example a fork. It names the channels and the keys that sign their files; after a switch the box trusts only these keys. A fork publishes it next to its public keys. The box reads it from a USB stick, from the file an administrator saved in Settings, or as typed at the console, and refuses unknown fields.

name.description: What the console and Settings show, and what is typed to confirm a switch: printable ASCII, so it can be typed on any console.

url.description: Where `channel.json` of a channel is, with `{channel}` for `stable` or `beta`; https only.

keys.description: The public keys whose signatures the box accepts after the switch, each for its channels.

publicKey.description: The Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes in base64 (what tools/release/create-key.sh prints).
